title: Subtree of Another Tree
problem: Given the roots of two binary trees root and subRoot, return true if there is a subtree of root with the same structure and node values of subRoot.
constraints: Number of nodes in root is up to 2000.
hints: Check if root is same tree as subRoot, or if subRoot is subtree of root.left or root.right.
expected_approach: Recursive root inspection with helper same-tree function.
